text: In accordance with Section 25 of the Board of Health Procedures By-law , regular meetings of the Board are determined by the Board and a schedule of those meetings shall be publicly available by the first meeting of the Board in each calendar year. On November 25 and 26, 2020, City Council considered Item ST6.1 , 2021 Schedule of Meetings, and adopted the 2021 annual schedule of meetings for City Council and its Standing Committees. The schedule also included proposed 2021 meeting dates for the Board of Health. The updated meeting schedule can be viewed on the City of Toronto's website at www.toronto.ca/council .

The Board of Health: 1. Approved the following 2021 meeting dates: - Monday January 18 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday March 22 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday April 12 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday May 10 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday June 14 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday September 20 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday October 25 at 9:30 a.m. - Monday December 6 at 9:30 a.m.
